Jeff Merkley for U.S. Senate, Oregon - http://www.jeffmerkley.com
## What Jeff’s Fighting For
Jeff Merkley has always been a progressive leader and a champion for people who need a chance. He’s a fighter who has the guts to do what’s right – no matter how powerful the forces against us.
## A We the People Democracy
Gerrymandering, voter suppression, and dark money have massively corrupted our “We the People” vision of our Constitution. The result is not government by and for the people, but government by and for the powerful and the privileged.
Our rigged government produces a rigged economy and tax system that continuously puts more and more money in the hands of those who already have the most, leaving millions of families struggling to make ends meet. It allows huge corporations to pollute our air and water and take advantage of their customers and workers. It helps those with power amass more and more wealth and power while sacrificing opportunity and our future.
There are 21 lobbyists for every member of Congress, over 11,000 in all, clamoring for attention and doling out favors. Billionaires and global corporations fuel SuperPACs, using the levers of power to make sure they get their way.
We must reclaim our Constitution. Put an end to gerrymandering. Overturn Citizens United and shut down the dark money. Reinstate and strengthen the Voting Rights Act to stop voter suppression and intimidation. Champion voter empowerment with required early voting periods, vote-by-mail, and same-day registration. And let’s replace the unjust Electoral College with the direct election of presidents through either a constitutional amendment or National Popular Vote!
## Reverse the Climate Crisis
The future of humanity is at risk. Day after day, year after year, we’re pumping way too much carbon pollution into the atmosphere. From the forest fires burning hotter and longer in the Northwest, to the more powerful hurricanes in the Southeast, and everywhere in-between, climate chaos is hitting America hard. Our forests, farms, and fisheries are threatened – putting lives and livelihoods at risk.
We must take bold action to reverse the climate crisis. Tinkering around the edges is no longer enough. We must invest in a shift to 100% clean and renewable energy sources. And we need a Green New Deal to ensure that as we drive this transition, we create millions of good-paying family jobs and invest in the front-line communities that have often been left behind. Everyone has a place in our clean energy future.
## Opportunity for Everyone
Jeff Merkley’s vision of America is one where every child has a full opportunity to thrive no matter which side of the railroad tracks he or she is born on.
But that vision is fading. Workers are working harder than ever, yet slipping further behind.
This is no accident. It is the result of trade policies that ship jobs overseas and a failure to invest in the foundations for thriving families -- affordable housing, quality education, health care, and good-paying jobs.
Let’s change that. We can create millions of good-paying jobs rebuilding America’s infrastructure from roads and bridges to docks and jetties. And let’s put high-speed broadband in every rural community in America.
Health care is just too expensive, complicated, and stressful. We should give every American the opportunity to participate in simple, seamless, cost-effective Medicare for All. And we must end the gouging of Americans on drug prices by banning drug companies from charging more for a drug than they charge in Canada, Europe, and Japan.
We should reduce class sizes in elementary schools, bring back shop classes and technical education, and give every young person who wants to the chance to go to college debt-free.
Housing and child care should be affordable in every community and to every family.
And may we truly be a nation of opportunity for all, fighting against discrimination, bigotry, and racism and fighting for the rights of workers to lift themselves up by forming unions and negotiating strong wages and benefits.
This is Jeff Merkley’s fight. If it’s your fight too, then join us. Together, we’ll get America back on track.

No presidential monument should be demolished without approval from Congress. 

Not the Kennedy Center, not the Jefferson Memorial, not the Lincoln Memorial. 

None.

I’m on the Senate floor forcing a vote on my bill to make sure no federal funds are used to build Trump’s Arch. 

This monument to his own ego is a complete waste of money. Taxpayers shouldn’t be footing the bill.
Republicans BLOCKED my bill to make sure YOUR tax dollars aren’t wasted on a monument to Trump’s ego.

I’m headed to the Senate floor to force a vote on the bill I’m leading with Sen. Murkowski to stop demolition of any national memorial to honor a U.S. president (like the Kennedy Center or the Jefferson Memorial) without an act of Congress.
 
Every Senator should be a YES on this.

Trump’s Republican allies in the Senate BLOCKED my bill with Senator Murkowski to stop the Kennedy Center—or any presidential national memorial—from being demolished without an act of Congress. Just shameful.

Lawmakers accepting “gratuities” for official actions is corruption, plain and simple. 

My Stop Corrupt Gratuities Act is a straightforward fix to strengthen federal anti-corruption laws. Let’s get this done!

HUGE: The Senate just passed my bipartisan bill with Senator John Curtis to give our communities the resources they need to face increasingly hotter and more dangerous wildfires while planning for hazardous smoke.
Trump’s arch is a monumental waste of money. Taxpayers shouldn’t be footing the bill for this illegal vanity project.

Completely morally bankrupt: the Trump Administration is forcing children—including a 3-year-old—to represent themselves in immigration court, in clear violation of law and precedent.

Cruelty is the point.
Trauma is the goal.
I’m focused on stopping it. 
 
www.cnn.com/2026/09/28/p...

I’m on the Senate floor to force a vote to block Trump’s illegal line item veto of funding already authorized by Congress. 

He’s violating the Constitution—we need to stop it!
Republicans BLOCKED my bill to stop Trump’s pocket recissions—illegal line item vetoes. Just shameful.

REPUBLICANS blocked my bill to ban congressional stock trading. Unacceptable—you should feel confident that public officials are making decisions in the publicinterest, not to pad their stock portfolios.
Trump’s arch is a monumental mistake, and I’ll fight like hell to block it.

We need to hit the brakes on billionaire corporations spying on you every time you start your car.

I introduced the Car Privacy Rights Act to protect consumers from the automakers collecting and selling your private data!
We can’t sleepwalk into a U.S.-Saudi Arabia nuclear deal that would hand Saudi Arabia the tools to build a nuclear bomb. No way.

I’m celebrating Manufacturing Day at Looptworks, learning about their revolutionary process for turning textile waste into new fiber! 

Making things in America—and here in Oregon—is crucial to building the middle class and our Made in Oregon economy.
We need to pass my Children’s Safe Welcome Act and put an end to the Trump Administration’s cruelty.

Egypt's raids and arrests of journalists at Matsadaash are an attack on independent investigative journalism. This clear disregard for press freedom is completely unacceptable, and these journalists must be released immediately.

We’re about to sleepwalk into a gravely dangerous nuclear deal with Saudi Arabia, and not enough people are talking about this.

Here’s what’s happening (thread)
Pure corruption.

This summer, I worked with colleagues across the aisle to send an ‘SOS’ call to Save Ocean Sensors—and we WON!

These critical sensors are essential for managing our fisheries, forecasting weather, and understanding climate change, and we saved them!

Trying to get anything done in the Senate feels like wading through tar. 

Senator Steve Daines and I have a bipartisan proposal to get back to debating, negotiating, and actually passing bills.
ICE and Border Patrol agents are terrorizing our friends and neighbors. Trump’s lawless federal agents trampling due process is completely wrong. These are not Oregon—or American—values.l

The Secure Rural Schools program—created by Oregon's own @wyden.senate.gov—is a lifeline for rural communities, providing funding that keeps schools and libraries open, maintains roads, and keeps communities safe. We need to pass this extension.

On Indigenous Peoples’ Day, we honor the rich legacy of Tribal communities that have been stewards of the land since time immemorial and reaffirm their sovereignty.
 
We must keep working to address historic and present-day injustices faced by Indigenous communities.
I’m fighting like hell to stop Trump from rigging the election and to protect our democratic republic.

Russian diesel to U.S.? Bad idea. It's not enough to lower prices here, but the drop in sanctions enriches Russia, funding their war against Ukraine.

And didn't Trump just sign the Graham Act that calls for much higher sanctions on Russia?
Americans see right through the Grifter-in-Chief and know the truth: Trump will never put the American people ahead of his bottom line.

When the cost of diesel goes up, the cost of just about everything else—from the food on your table to the clothes in your closet—all go up with it.

Farmers, truckers, families like yours and mine—all getting squeezed. That’s Trumpflation.

I refuse to let the U.S. sleepwalk into a dangerous nuclear deal with Saudi Arabia. The law gives Congress the power to review and block a deal like this.

@markey.senate.gov and I are making sure the Senate fulfills that responsibility before it’s too late.

My team and I are closely monitoring reports of an active shooter situation at Silver Rail Elementary School in Bend.

As details continue to come out, my heart is with the Bend community and all of the students and families affected.

No one should have to fear violence at school.

Please continue to hold the students, teachers, families, and entire Silver Rail Elementary School community in your hearts as details continue to emerge about the victims.

I am grateful to the first responders and emergency personnel responding to this horrific shooting.

As we awake to a new day, my thoughts are with the families of the three children and one teacher killed in the horrific assault yesterday.

Let’s hold the entire Bend community in our hearts and pray for a full recovery for the teacher and student still in the hospital.
All of our hearts are with Bend.

Trump wants an Epstein Elite golf course to replace D.C.’s affordable public East Potomac Links golf course. 

No place for fishing...
No place for running...
No place for biking...
No place for walking...

Hundreds of trees cut down.

Trumpflation is soaring—and families in Oregon and across the country are feeling the strain everywhere from the gas pump to the grocery store. 

I’m focused on ending Trump’s illegal war with Iran and bringing costs down for American families.

A beautiful remembrance of Megan Lambert, whose passion for education touched so many lives. 

Our hearts are with Silver Rail Elementary.
Remembering Rhoam Summer and the light he brought into the world and holding the Summer family and his friends in my heart.

Israeli settlers are assaulting Palestinian olive farmers in the West Bank and the journalists documenting the harassment. Inaction by the IDF gives settlers permission to continue their threats and violence. We must protect farmers and the olive harvest.

Families across the country are being crushed by brutal utility bills. 

Instead of fighting for families, Trump and Republicans are gutting the programs that help folks afford utilities as Trump’s illegal war in Iran drives energy costs through the roof.

Anyone can observe our elections, but they need to follow the law—that includes the Department of Justice.
 
Oregon will have fair, secure, and accurate elections in 2026, without interference from the Trump Administration.

And it begins...

A major danger for our Republic: Trump will try to get Secretaries of State not to certify election results.

We will fight like hell against his election rigging.

Farmers across America are on track to spend an extra $2.4 billion on diesel alone this year, thanks to Trump’s unconstitutional war with Iran. 

Just plain wrong—one of the many reasons I’m working to rein in this illegal war.

Trump is making a fortune off of his illegal war with Iran—and we’re all paying the price.
 
He will never put the good of the American people above his bottom line.
I worked with @wyden.senate.gov  to secure a federal investment in Mariposa Village—which will provide much-needed affordable housing to Oregonians. Wonderful to see this project coming to life!

My team and I are in close contact with local and state officials following the devastating Pacific Seafood plant fire in Newport. I’m grateful to the first responders working hard to keep the community safe and will work to make sure the community has the support needed for recovery.
Sheer stupidity.
Great to speak at the Oregon Building Trades convention. The future belongs to nations that invest in infrastructure—and members of the Oregon Building Trades Union are building America’s future!

Dolores Huerta leaves behind a rich legacy of helping farmworkers win landmark labor protections, securing protections for immigrants, and mentoring a new generation of leaders.

The world is better because of her work—my heart is with her loved ones and community navigating the grief of this loss.

Almost unbelievable: Trump has made more stock trades during his second term than ALL of Congress combined.

I’m pushing to ban all elected officials—members of Congress, the President, the VP—from buying and trading stocks.

Here’s what we should be spending $1.8 billion on: 
  
600+ million school lunches 
Salaries for 27,000+ new teachers 
School supplies for 10.5 million kids for a year 
  
Not on Trump’s ego-fueled vanity projects. He’s wasting our tax dollars on himself.

Oregon: make sure your voice is heard in this election! 

Don’t delay—use OregonVotes.gov to find a drop box near you and drop off your ballot today.
Have a spooky and safe Halloween! 🎃

Americans are getting gouged at the gas pump—but Trump’s Dirty Energy CEO pals are RAKING in cash.
 
They’re profiting from Trump’s war of choice with Iran, and we’re left holding the bag.
 
I’m fighting to end Trump’s illegal war and bring down costs.

Election Day is Tuesday, 11/3! Visit OregonVotes.gov to find a drop box near you. 
 
Your vote is your voice!

Wishing my friend @chrismurphyct.bsky.social a rapid and full recovery. 

Chris, you’re a fighter, and we look forward to welcoming you back to the Senate.

Great to be back at the Oregon Coast Economic Summit to talk about the crucial role our coastal communities play in Oregon—and how we can work together to keep growing and strengthening coastal economies.

The Egyptian government continues its assault on independent journalism, this time shuttering Mada Masr and targeting Editor-in-Chief Lina Attalah.
 
We must forcefully condemn attacks on the free press whenever and wherever they happen.

I joined @wyden.senate.gov, @repbonamici.bsky.social, local leaders, and providers to discuss how we can reimagine health care to improve quality and slash costs for every Oregonian. Healthy people are more important than healthy profits—these conversations will help shape the future of health care.

Trump and his Dirty Oil CEO buddies are making a fortune—while you get gouged.
 
With Trump, it’s families lose and billionaires win.
 
I’m fighting for a vision where families thrive and billionaires pay their fair share.

Oregon: It’s Election Day! Drop off your ballot by 8 pm to make sure your voice is heard. 
 
Find a drop box near you at OregonVotes.gov.
